response.sql: WITH account_transaction_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city, COUNT(ft.transaction_id) as transaction_count FROM Accounts a JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city), town_totals AS (SELECT town_city, SUM(transaction_count) as town_total_transactions FROM account_transaction_counts GROUP BY town_city), global_average AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(transaction_count) AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(19,4)) as avg_transactions_per_account FROM account_transaction_counts) SELECT atc.account_id, atc.town_city, atc.transaction_count, CAST(atc.transaction_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / CAST(tt.town_total_transactions AS DECIMAL(19,4)) as town_share, CAST(atc.transaction_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / ga.avg_transactions_per_account as ratio_to_average FROM account_transaction_counts atc JOIN town_totals tt ON atc.town_city = tt.town_city CROSS JOIN global_average ga ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10
